guidance.statement: Revenue growth guided at around 12% a year, with actual outcomes possibly 12-15%.
Blended EBITDA margin guided at around 14% on a conservative basis.
Operating cash flow to turn positive in FY27 as vessel deliveries release tail payments.
Green Maritime Propulsion JV targeting revenue of ₹640 Cr by the 5th year (2031) at a ballpark 20% EBITDA margin.
ISRF revenue expected at ~₹600 Cr over the next 2 years, scaling to ₹1,000-1,200 Cr over 5 years.
Vadinar revenue to start 36 months after environmental clearance, beginning at ₹300-600 Cr.
Tuticorin revenue expected to start at ₹650-700 Cr and scale to ₹1,800-2,000 Cr over 7-8 years.
Capex to be funded at an 80:20 debt-equity ratio, with a 25% Shipbuilding Development Scheme subsidy and 3% interest subvention.

entities.name: International Ship Repair Facility (ISRF), Willingdon Island, Kochi

industry: Industrials > Capital Goods > Industrial Manufacturing > Ship Building & Allied Services

operating_notes.text: Unexecuted order book ~₹22,000 Cr; L1 for five Navy survey vessels worth ~₹5,000 Cr, expected to be inked around November 2026.
Shipbuilding is ~70% of turnover at 10-12% margin and ship repair ~30% at 20-24%, giving a blended ~14-15%.
Block fabrication capacity is 12,000 tonnes per year at the main facility, rising to ~72,000 tonnes with the planned 60,000-tonne independent facility.

watchlist.text: Operating cash flow positive in FY27
Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways approval for the ISRF JV
Shareholder approval via postal ballot for the ISRF undertaking transfer

watchlist.response: European export orders are tail-ended, with only ~30% received during construction; delivery of ~10 vessels in FY27 should make cash flow positive.
watchlist.text: Operating cash flow was negative in FY26 despite strong PAT, and a new investment cycle is starting.

watchlist.response: Higher past margins came from nominated aircraft-carrier work and interest income on a ₹2,000-3,000 Cr cash surplus, which is no longer available after spending ₹3,000 Cr on ISRF and the drydock.
watchlist.text: Why FY27 EBITDA margin guidance of 14% is far below the last three years' margins.

watchlist.response: Navy is yet to issue the LPD RFP; P-17 Bravo RFP is out with a 3-4 month bid window, but finalisation timelines are not in CSL's control.
watchlist.text: Timeline for large defence orders (LPD, MCMV, P-17 Bravo).
